test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given bar graph shows the marks obtained by five students in Exam I and Exam II.Study the graph carefully to answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ee43ea944fe67792d9dceb45aea131a347a09f0be6dbf6f47ad33c668ebb8d1.png] 

The marks obtain by Naveen in Exam-II are what per cent of the total marks obtained by all five students in Exam-II?
solution:
**Given:**

Exam-II Marks:

Surya = 90

Kiran = 110

Mukesh = 100

Naveen = 120

Suresh = 60

**Formula used:**

Required % = (Naveen's marks ÷ Total marks of all students) × 100

**Calculations:**

Total = 90 + 110 + 100 + 120 + 60 = 480

⇒ Required % = (120 ÷ 480) × 100 = 25%

**∴ Naveen’s marks in Exam-II are 25% of total Exam-II marks.**
